description: For every dataset: how many places it covers, out of how many at its grain, plus the source's own coverage caveat. Pass `dataset` (a slug from list_datasets) to list the places that dataset lacks, with the gaps by region. Use it before telling anyone data does not exist for a place, and to explain a null. Missing means no figure, never a zero. Keys a source publishes that match no current place (a superseded province code) are reported and never mapped onto a current place. Drafts are listed as not served, without counts.

dataset.description: A dataset slug from /datasets. Omit it for the summary of every dataset; pass it to list the places that dataset lacks.

limit.description: Missing places per page when dataset is given, 1–100. Default 50.

offset.description: Missing places to skip, for the next page.

name: get_coverage

page.description: The expatliving.it page these figures come from — link it when you quote them.

covered.description: Places with a figure. null when not served.

grain.description: The geographic level the source publishes at. NUTS 2 and NUTS 3 are Eurostat/OECD statistical regions — close to, but not the same as, Italy's regions and provinces. Never present a coarser-grain value as if it were measured for one comune.

keysOutsideCurrentList.description: Keys the source publishes that match no place on the current list (e.g. a superseded province code). Never mapped onto a current place.

missing.description: Places with no figure: of minus covered. Absent data, never a zero.

missingPlacesQuery.description: Path that lists the missing places: GET /meta/coverage?dataset=.

note.description: The source's own coverage caveat, or why no count is given.

of.description: Places at this grain (comuni, provinces or regions). null when there is no fixed list.

page.description: The human-readable page for this dataset on expatliving.it — link readers here.

servable.description: False while a hand-curated dataset is still "draft" (unverified against its legislation). A non-servable dataset returns no values anywhere in this API.

source.description: The institution to cite, e.g. "ISTAT" or "Eurostat".

status.description: complete: every place at this grain. partial: some places missing. universe_not_fixed: NUTS or national data with no fixed list of places to count against. not_served: a draft dataset, whose figures and counts are not published.

vintage.description: The period the data describes, e.g. "2025H2", "2024" or "2015–2024" — not when it was fetched.

missingPlaces.description: Present only when `dataset` was given and it has missing places.

byRegion.description: Where the gaps are, region by region, over the whole list (not just this page).

code.description: ISTAT code for a comune, sigla for a province, name for a region.

title: What is missing, by dataset
